scope: 13 actual schema4 GPU audits from direct results/audit_* directories only; historical archives excluded.

evidence_boundary.observed: Actual CUDA worker weights/scales, selected online FP8 method/class, real first warmup request identity, executed Text Encoder BF16 I/O, 32-block prefix prefill/decode storage metadata and bytes, and BF16 attention input/backend.
evidence_boundary.not_established_by_this_audit: Executed FP8 GEMM/FA3 GPU kernel identity, numerical scale validity, peak allocator/device memory, latency, image quality or acceptance. Those require profiler/measurement/quality evidence.
evidence_boundary.cache_bytes: Sum of stored K/V tensors and any FP32 scales across 32 blocks; unique backing-storage bytes independently deduplicated. Excludes allocator overhead and transient dequantization/attention buffers.
evidence_boundary.capture: First real warmup request after engine initialization; initialization calls without a marker are excluded. Warmup uses the same frozen case as the completed measured request.

case.prompt: Let this mascot dance under the moon, surrounded by floating stars

independent_verification.scope: Actual worker weights/scales, selected online method, executed BF16 module I/O, prefill/decode prefix storage precision/bytes and BF16 attention. Not executed-GEMM proof, peak VRAM, quality or performance proof.

case.prompt: Create a realistic studio photograph using both reference images. Use the astronaut in the first image as the person: preserve her face, hairstyle, orange spacesuit and patches. Place the espresso cup, saucer and spoon from the second image on a small wooden table in front of her. Preserve the cup's brown exterior, white interior and coffee, and the spoon's metallic appearance. Use a plain light-gray background. Keep the person and the cup clearly visible; add no other people, cups or text.
targets: person from first reference with preserved face, hair and orange spacesuit
cup, saucer, spoon and coffee from second reference
cup set on small wooden table in front of person
light-gray background and no extra people, cups or text
